english.title: Impede or prevent elector or proxy from voting
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of undue influence, and therefore a corrupt practice, in that, by

(A)_[abduction]_
(B)_[duress]_
(C)_[a fraudulent device or contrivance, namely **(..SPECIFY DEVICE OR CONTRIVANCE..),]_

you

(D)_[impeded or prevented the free exercise of the franchise of ]_
(E)_[intended to impede or prevent the free exercise of the franchise of ]_
(F)_[so compelled, induced or prevailed upon]_
(G)_[intended so to compel, induce or prevail upon]_

(H)_[an elector,]_
(I)_[a proxy for an elector,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTOR OR PROXY..) to vote or to refrain from voting
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 115(2)(b) and 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
by abduction, duress or fraudulent device or contrivance
impeded or prevented, or intended to impede or prevent
the free exercise of the franchise of an elector or proxy for an elector
or so compels, induces or prevails upon, or intends so to compel, induce or prevail upon
an elector or proxy for an elector either to vote or to refrain from voting

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
